tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Window background and the main content pane.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Inputs, tables, cards, dialogs and menus — anything that sits on surface.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: The sidebar, the title bar and inactive panes.

tokens.name: surface-hover
tokens.usage: Hovered rows, menu items and ghost buttons.

tokens.name: surface-selected
tokens.usage: The selected tree row or table row; pairs with ink.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines between panes, rows and table cells. Decorative only — never the only border of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, checkboxes, switches and secondary buttons (3:1 on surface and surface-raised).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface, on surface-selected and on all *-soft tints.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: attribute names, metadata, hints, column headers. On surface, surface-raised, surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels, on surface-raised and surface. Disabled text is exempt from 4.5:1; placeholders still meet it on surface-raised.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: The Kanopa green. Primary button fill, checked checkbox and switch fill. Text on it is on-moss. A fill only — never text, and never the only cue for a state.

tokens.name: moss-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of a moss fill.

tokens.name: moss-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted backgrounds: selected chips, the active connection, a highlighted search hit.

tokens.name: moss-ink
tokens.usage: Brand-coloured text and icons: links, the active tab label and its underline, counts. On every surface and moss-soft.

tokens.name: on-moss
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a moss fill.

tokens.name: fern
tokens.usage: Logo only: the upper node of the Branch K mark (3.4:1 or more on every light surface).

tokens.name: pine
tokens.usage: Logo only: the lower node of the Branch K mark (5:1 or more on every surface).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring colour (solid, 2px, 3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Links — an alias of moss-ink.

tokens.name: lichen
tokens.usage: Organizational units and containers: the icon tile behind an OU glyph.

tokens.name: lichen-ink
tokens.usage: Glyph on a lichen tile; OU-related text.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: People (inetOrgPerson, user): the icon tile behind a person glyph. Also the info tint.

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: Glyph on a sky tile; info text and icons on surfaces and sky.

tokens.name: heather
tokens.usage: Groups and object classes: tile and tag fill.

tokens.name: heather-ink
tokens.usage: Glyph on a heather tile; object-class tag text.

tokens.name: bark
tokens.usage: Directory roots, servers and schema entries: tile fill.

tokens.name: bark-ink
tokens.usage: Glyph on a bark tile; root/server text.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success banners and the Connected badge.

tokens.name: success-ink
tokens.usage: Success text and icons (a blue-leaning teal, so it is never told from danger by red–green hue alone).

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Background of warning banners, e.g. an unencrypted bind.

tokens.name: warning-ink
tokens.usage: Warning text and icons on surfaces and warning-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error banners and failed-bind badges.

tokens.name: danger-ink
tokens.usage: Error text and icons on surfaces and danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Fill of the destructive button (Delete entry). Text on it is on-danger.

tokens.name: danger-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of the destructive fill.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Background of info banners — an alias of sky.

tokens.name: info-ink
tokens.usage: Info text and icons — an alias of sky-ink.

tokens.name: syn-attr
tokens.usage: Syntax: attribute names and descriptions (objectClass, mail;lang-fr) in LDIF and filters.

tokens.name: syn-dn
tokens.usage: Syntax: the value of a dn: line, and DN-valued attributes.

tokens.name: syn-value
tokens.usage: Syntax: plain attribute values and filter assertion values.

tokens.name: syn-keyword
tokens.usage: Syntax: LDIF control words — version, changetype and its add/modify/delete/modrdn, add:/replace:/delete: lines, newrdn, deleteoldrdn, newsuperior.

tokens.name: syn-encoded
tokens.usage: Syntax: base64 values (::), URL values (:<) and escaped bytes (\2a) in filters.

tokens.name: syn-operator
tokens.usage: Syntax: filter operators (& | ! = ~= >= <= :=), the * wildcard, and the - separator line in LDIF.

tokens.name: syn-punct
tokens.usage: Syntax: parentheses, colons and line numbers.

tokens.name: syn-comment
tokens.usage: Syntax: # comment lines, set in italic.

tokens.name: syn-error
tokens.usage: Syntax: the wavy underline and gutter marker on a line the parser rejects.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind a modal dialog.

tokens.name: chrome-mac-close
tokens.usage: macOS window close light (OS colour, never re-tinted).

tokens.name: chrome-mac-min
tokens.usage: macOS minimise light.

tokens.name: chrome-mac-zoom
tokens.usage: macOS zoom light.

tokens.name: chrome-win-close
tokens.usage: Windows caption close button hover (OS colour); its glyph is white.

families.sans: Inter, "Segoe UI Variable", "Segoe UI", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", "Cascadia Mono", "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

groups.name: Interface
groups.note: Inter, bundled with the app on both platforms. 13px is the working size of a desktop tool; nothing in the UI goes below 11px.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Empty states and the welcome screen only.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: The entry header and dialog titles.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Default UI text: tree rows, table cells, form values, menus.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body text and button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Form labels, column headers, badges, tab labels.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Sidebar section labels, set in capitals. Never for sentences.

groups.name: Directory data
groups.note: JetBrains Mono for anything a server returns or accepts verbatim: DNs, attribute values, filters, LDIF, OIDs.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: DNs and attribute values in tables and fields (row-aligned with body).

styles.name: code-strong
styles.usage: Attribute names when shown raw, and the RDN part of a DN.

styles.name: code-block
styles.usage: The LDIF editor and the filter editor.

spacing.note: 4px base. Desktop density: rows are 28px, panes pad 12–16px.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; padding inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of small controls; gap between toolbar buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control padding; gutter between form fields; pane padding in dense views.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Pane and dialog padding; gap between groups of fields.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Tree indent per level.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a pane; dialog padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Around empty-state illustrations and the welcome screen.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Outer margin of the welcome screen.

radius.note: Soft like river stones; never sharp, never bubbly. Pills only for status.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Entry-type icon tiles, checkboxes, kbd keys, tree rows.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, selects, badges, menu items.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, banners, tables, popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the app window.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Status pills, switch tracks, the connection dot.

shadow.note: Low and diffuse in Clearing; in Night forest a darker drop plus a 1px top light.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and cards at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-md
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers, autocomplete for attributes.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Dialogs and the app window.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 2px gap in the surface colour, then 2px of solid focus green. Applied as box-shadow so it follows the radius.

size.note: Fixed control heights keep the tree, table and toolbar on one rhythm.

tokens.name: size-control-sm
tokens.usage: Toolbar buttons, inline table actions, compact selects.

tokens.name: size-control
tokens.usage: Default height of buttons, inputs and selects.

tokens.name: size-control-lg
tokens.usage: Primary actions in dialogs and the connect form.

tokens.name: size-row
tokens.usage: Tree rows and attribute-table rows.

tokens.name: size-titlebar
tokens.usage: Unified title bar + toolbar height on both platforms.

tokens.name: size-sidebar
tokens.usage: Default sidebar (directory tree) width; resizable 200–480px.
